metadata.description: Tools for working with Claude across the planning chat and Claude Code: an idea-to-project pipeline and a two-way handoff between planning and coding sessions.

plugins.name: idea-forge
plugins.description: A council of critics gives an idea a verdict, a council of builders refines it, then the project folder, the full documentation set and the Claude Code setup are generated.

plugins.name: code-handoff
plugins.description: Claude Code writes a summary of every turn for your planning chat, and the planning chat writes the next prompt back for /next. No more screenshots.
